nodes.label: OAuth and SSO flow safeguards
nodes.rationale: Preserve exact redirect and origin checks, PKCE, one-use challenges, and session revocation; browser success text alone does not prove a host connection.

nodes.label: FedCM and SSO hub origins
nodes.rationale: Explicit data authority is selected before deployment metadata, and custom client hub overrides do not grant CSP permission.

nodes.label: Lopu browser Actions identity binding
nodes.rationale: Only the server-only canonical data-route helper installs the credential-free identity, excluding control-plane and reveal APIs.

nodes.label: Lopu prompt settings
nodes.rationale: Account-keyed mounting and private in-memory caching prevent cross-account drafts; prompt text never grants server tool authority.

nodes.label: Password manager
nodes.rationale: Decrypted fields intentionally bypass shared request diagnostics and automatic origin fallback to keep secrets out of shared client history and cache.

nodes.label: Password vault and provider ceremony
nodes.rationale: After selection, approval reads only the exact credential before and after signing.

nodes.label: Password browser extension
nodes.rationale: The adapter fences the active document and accepts diagnostic reads only from its own popup; projected status hints are not authority or ceremony evidence.

nodes.label: Password website normalization and allowlist
nodes.rationale: URL normalization is not an authorization grant.

nodes.label: Native password connection
nodes.rationale: Status is read-only and does not probe the network or assert OS AutoFill enablement.

nodes.label: Native password provider
nodes.rationale: The provider preserves device authentication, cancellation, retry, session fences and immutable registration retry identity.

nodes.label: Account content snapshots
nodes.rationale: The offline reader has no authority to write an account or sign in.

nodes.label: AI provider model availability
nodes.rationale: Provider model lists are published atomically with a durable settings lease and cooldown, and model-not-found refresh is bounded without replay.

nodes.label: iOS release automation
nodes.rationale: GitHub OIDC is narrowly scoped to the fixed iOS release integration after immutable repository, owner, main workflow, event and source checks.

nodes.label: Password migration coverage and encrypted lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Every original 1PUX member is retained as an encrypted attachment to a source archive entry.

nodes.label: Claude keyless model discovery
nodes.rationale: Public provenance is stored separately from credential availability, preserving admission choices and absent catalogue rows.

nodes.label: Incident cleanup
nodes.rationale: Cleanup is incident-specific, requires dry-run and confirmation, checks exact identity and idle account state, and cannot accept arbitrary target accounts.

nodes.label: OpenAI environment-to-vault import
nodes.rationale: The import is same-origin, admin-only, create-only and uses the server environment as its sole source.

nodes.label: Local ChatGPT plan connections
nodes.rationale: Protected local credentials, loopback callbacks, one-use attempts and account/session/origin fences constrain the connection; model use has strict saved plan pins and no billing fallback.
